title: Homogeneous

inlines.v: HOMOGE'NEOUS, adjective [Gr. like, and kind.] Of the same kind or nature; consisting of similar parts, or of elements of the like nature. Thus we say, homogeneous particles, elements or principles; homogeneous bodies.
